name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck: orders and kitchen
promotionalText: Receive advance orders, protect your kitchen from excess orders and keep serving when the signal drops. The ordering app for the food truck team.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team runs service with.

Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Your team sees all orders on one screen, confirms what the kitchen can prepare and then marks each one as ready and collected.

NEVER PROMISE A TIME YOU CAN’T MEET
Set how much your kitchen can prepare at once and how long it takes. When a collection time fills up, customers can no longer choose it, and so the queue keeps pace with the kitchen.

TAKE ORDERS AT THE COUNTER
Add orders placed at the counter (walk-up) on the same screen as advance orders, so the kitchen works from a single queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen shows what to prepare now, what comes next and what is ready, with an alert when it’s time to start an order.

PRINT ORDER TICKETS
Connect a thermal printer in the kitchen over Bluetooth or through your local network, and order tickets are printed automatically.

KEEP SERVING WHEN THE SIGNAL DROPS
Turn on offline protection: if the connection drops, advance orders are paused so nobody places an order you won’t see. Orders you enter on the device are kept and are synced when you’re back online.

MADE FOR THE FOOD TRUCK
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during service, get an alert when an order needs confirming and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
Set up your events and locations just once and receive orders for each of them.

HatchGrab is for food truck owners and their teams. You need a HatchGrab account to sign in.
